notes.title: Pre-launch Update
notes.notes:
Hey Spreadsheet Surfers,

Launch time is almost here! 

Just as a reminder, here are our launch times for various time zones for 21st August:

11pm AEST (Australia East)
9pm JST (Japan)
6pm IST (India)
2pm BST (UK)
10am BRT (Brazil)
9am EDT (New York)
6am PST (California)

It's been a wild ride for us at Fenix Studios but we couldn't have done it without you guys. Not just the new followers on our many socials, but especially those from our old steam page who were kind enough to leave reviews. We wholeheartedly welcome you to leave another review on release!

Also a huge thanks to those of you who wishlisted recently, we're extremely grateful for your support!

Since this is our first ever title, we've learnt so much about the game development world. Especially how hard it is to market a game! Hopefully next time, we can do things better and more efficiently. 

The only thing left for us to do now is try and get the wishlist count up as much as we can, right up to launch time. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/231a4ec16ea1b5b79dea90c6ed2d60ea4cbcdda3.png


Launch Campaign: more details soon...

We at Fenix Studios are no strangers to redundancies. Many of our own developers have been made redundant before. Office Fight's existence, while mostly just for fun, hopefully brings a bit more awareness into the world about job loss, lay-offs, and overall workplace frustration. 

To celebrate the launch, we're planning something special in regards to this sentiment. You could even be getting the game for free! This will be a limited window however, so wishlisting will help you stay up to date as this unfolds.

Many thanks again and we'll be posting another update on launch,

- Fenix Studios

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey Pencil Pushers!

Just a quick update that we've updated the demo! The focus of this update is mostly around localisation and also minor bugs/clean up. Now even more people can play Office Fight around the world!

Fixed bugs include:
- Character asset clean up
- Enabled localisation for French, Portugese, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, Russian.
- Minor UI fixes

Office Fight will be launching August 21st so prepare your slingshot skills and get ready to cause some sweet office destruction! Every wishlist goes a long way so hit that button and stay up to date with all our updates.

notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCED!
notes.notes:
Attention all cubicle combatants! 

We are stoked to announce that Office Fight will be crashing into your computers on August 21.

[previewyoutube=q2umtYwHpiY;full][/previewyoutube]

From exploding printers to deadly robovacs, you’ll have every office item in your arsenal as you smash your way through Mega Corp in this office destruction game full of physics-based puzzles and action-packed boss fights.

Can’t wait till August 21? Go try out our exciting new demo live on Steam NOW. Yup, that's right, thanks to all your feedback we have gone and overhauled the showcased levels so you get a better slice of the game, updated our tutorials to make gameplay and controls clearer, and added a fun new rune you unlock once you defeat the boss; pssst: this is the infamous Impact Rune that really showcases the destruction capabilities of Office Fight!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/637f5eebba48a509e57985433804ed15bb162e21.gif

So, sharpen your staplers, flex those RSI-riddled fingers, and prepare for the most epic office brawl of your gaming career.

Work Sucks. Break Stuff!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/fbf3f9ccca9bc1b5a243e9edd24a7656c1f400e3.png

notes.title: New Demo Update! Release is approaching!
notes.notes:
Hey Payroll Punters!


We've got some exciting updates to share!
A shiny new update to the demo is about to hit containing all the awesome feedback we've been getting from everyone! This will contain updated tutorials, a change of levels, and a new rune for people to play with.

We've gone further and beyond to make sure you feel satisfied with your damage. Build that multiplier then unleash your rage to get that maximum score!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/9a159bffb4c3e01b210d1a51327ea9b06256e54f.png
A new rune is available for people to enjoy once you defeat Karon. This is the infamous Impact Rune that really showcases the destruction capabilities of Office Fight!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/637f5eebba48a509e57985433804ed15bb162e21.gif

We've mixed up the levels a bit to keep things fresh. While the current version portrays the variety of levels in the game, we felt that as we approach the release date, we wanted to keep some things a surprise.

Speaking of the release date, we'll be making a release date announcement very soon. So don't forget to follow our socials for the latest updates. If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to hit us up!
